neighbours.label: the 'of' link right after a disease or danger word in Korean, Japanese or Chinese, heading into an abstract noun like risk, chance or prevention: Korean 의 (간암의 위험, 사고의 위험), Japanese の (糖尿病の危険性, 心臓病の予防), Chinese 患+disease before 的 (患肝癌的风险, peak on the disease token). Silent on bare disease names (糖尿病患者, 폐암 진단), on ordinary possessives (私の傘, 친구의 가방, 我朋友的书) and in English 'risk of'.
neighbours.short: CJK 'of' particle after a disease/danger word (risk of X)
